These libfuse2 API headers are copied from macFUSE 4.x, installed at
`/usr/local/include/fuse` on the development machine. They are used only to
compile `fuse_bridge.c`; the resulting executable loads the macFUSE or FUSE-T
runtime installed on the user's Mac. The header copyright notices state
LGPLv2; the license text is in `COPYING.LIB`.

FUSE-T documents the libfuse2 API as compatible with macFUSE:
https://github.com/macos-fuse-t/fuse-t/wiki
